name: How do I know if my plumbing issue requires a main water shutoff?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my plumbing issue requires a main water shutoff?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many plumbing issues, especially those involving significant leaks, pipe replacement, or fixture installation, necessitate a main water shutoff. If you have a burst pipe, a continuously running toilet that won't stop at the local shutoff, or are planning a major appliance installation, a main shutoff is usually required. Our technicians will assess your specific situation and advise on the necessity of a main water shutoff during the initial inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Main water shutoff is often needed for major leaks, pipe replacements, or fixture installations. Our technicians will assess and advise.
